R3 pose stiffness table for REV-GNC-7 (fea3d, written 2026-10-20T18:02:43Z (date -u); lead 17:33:40Z: "For REV-GNC-7: the R3 K
table must carry each pose's own values and its fraction.  It must state that cone poses stiffen more than stop045 did (combined045
+14.4 % coupled alpha against +13.35 %).  GNC sets its K band from the full R3 table").

Per pose (8 stops at 8 deg, neutral, 8 range-cone poses at 7 deg) and per quantity (FE rigid servo, servo k_s 58 / 174 N m/rad in series;
coupled = other axis moment-free, diagonal = other axis held; alpha = outer axis X, beta = inner axis ring Y), all N m/rad:
  v3.5.1   the RM2-05 corrected v3.5.1 value of the c71 pose run (results/k_stop_c71_v352.json / k_cone_c71_v352.json);
  R3       the v3.5.2 R3 lever-run value (results/k_pose_<pose>_v352r3R3.json; stop045: results/k_stop045_v352r3R3_check.json);
  delta    R3 / v3.5.1 - 1;  fraction = delta / (the stop045 delta of the same quantity), the measure the release bands use
           (original RM2-05 band [v351, v351 (1 + d)], lead 14:11Z (2); cone-pose band [v351, v351 (1 + 1.25 d)], lead 17:33:40Z (b)).
Range: min / max of every quantity over the posted R3 poses, with the pose: the input GNC sets its K band from.
Evidence: SIM (FE unit angular-acceleration steps EAX / EAY on the v3.5.2 R3 pose runs) + DERIVED (servo output compliance in series,
r_eff per servo and pose; k_s 58 / 174 N m/rad ASSUMED, TO-VERIFY bench B-TVC).  Poses not yet posted are listed as PENDING.
2026-10-20T18:16:48Z (date -u), lead 18:04:32Z: "Record the sign pattern (beta > 0 cones split on the with-servo pairs, beta < 0 cones on
the FE pairs) as information for the REV-GNC-7 K-table note": 'pair_pattern' / 'pair_pattern_note' (computed from the posted cone poses),
with the release rule's pair envelope (item 2 as recalibrated 18:04:32Z: FE 0.17 / with servo 0.71 % of K).
2026-10-20T18:41:24Z (date -u), lead 18:40:44Z (acceptance of the 13 chain-E R3 poses): the table is the REV-GNC-7 input and carries
each pose's own values and fractions, the poses above the original band named as ACCEPTED ABOVE THE ORIGINAL BAND (lead 18:40:44Z),
the beta sign trend of the fraction (computed from the posted poses) and stop045's 'no fbd record' note.  Lead finding (18:40:44Z):
"the original band assumed the stop045 delta bounds every pose, and that does not hold ... a consistent geometric effect, not a run
defect.  The band stays a screen for a gross model error (several % of K)".
evidence: SIM (FE unit steps on the v3.5.2 R3 pose runs) + DERIVED (servo in series; k_s 58 / 174 N m/rad ASSUMED, TO-VERIFY bench B-TVC)
statement: Cone poses stiffen more than stop045 did between v3.5.1 and v3.5.2 R3: combined045 FE coupled alpha +14.4 % against stop045's +13.35 %; poses with a fraction above 1 (largest per pose): cone poses beta+ 1.201, combined045 1.081, combined315 1.077; stop poses stop000 1.208.  The RM2-05 band built from the stop045 delta therefore does not bound every pose; GNC sets its K band from the full R3 table (the range below), not from stop045.
pair_pattern_note: Information (lead 18:04:32Z): coupled / diagonal split of the cone poses (|coupled delta % - diagonal delta %|, % of K): combined045 (beta +4.94 deg) splits on the with-servo pairs: FE 0.031-0.033, with servo 0.346-0.432; combined135 (beta -4.94 deg) splits on the FE pairs: FE 0.084-0.089, with servo 0.030-0.059; combined225 (beta -4.94 deg) splits on the FE pairs: FE 0.100-0.107, with servo 0.027-0.056; combined315 (beta +4.94 deg) splits on the with-servo pairs: FE 0.040-0.042, with servo 0.325-0.406.  Pattern: beta > 0 cones split on the with-servo pairs, beta < 0 cones on the FE pairs.  Release rule item 2 (lead 18:04:32Z): per pair type, the split must not exceed its envelope over the poses accepted under the original band, FE 0.17 / with servo 0.71 % of K (runs/cone_pair_check_allposes.json 9840d1c4ca64c166); all 4 posted cone poses are inside it.

beta_sign_trend_note: Beta sign trend (computed over the 16 non-reference poses posted): the fraction of the stop045 delta runs from 0.17 to 1.208 and follows the sign of beta: beta > 0: stop000 1.208, beta+ 1.201, combined045 1.081, combined315 1.077, stop315 0.998; beta = 0: 0.52-0.99; beta < 0: 0.17-0.82 (fraction_max per pose for beta > 0; min-max otherwise).
stop045_note: stop045 (the band reference, run 08:19Z): no fbd record (check_fbd postdates it; its fields were (C)-trimmed at 13:30Z); ACCEPTED without a re-solve (lead 18:40:44Z); its mirror pose stop315 corroborates its delta (fractions 0.955-0.998, fbd 0.0087 N); its env npz and posts are present.
